description: This header file declares structures, macros, and functions related to managing a sparse index in a version control system or similar project. It includes mechanisms for controlling index sparsity, expanding sparse directories, and configuring sparse index behavior.

methods.name: is_sparse_index_allowed
methods.description: Checks if sparse index is permitted given the current index state and flags.

methods.name: convert_to_sparse
methods.description: Converts the current index to a sparse index based on provided flags.

methods.name: ensure_correct_sparsity
methods.description: Ensures the index has the correct sparsity settings.

methods.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files
methods.description: Removes skip-worktree flags from present files in the index.

methods.name: expand_to_path
methods.description: Expands a given sparse index to include a specific path, possibly outside the current sparse checkout definition.

methods.name: set_sparse_index_config
methods.description: Configures sparse index settings for a repository.

methods.name: expand_index
methods.description: Expands the sparse index according to a pattern list, including files within specific patterns.

methods.name: ensure_full_index
methods.description: Ensures the index contains all entries, expanding any sparse directories as needed.
